mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the 20-day horizon as investors shift capital toward risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.1% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 280.5 signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the 20-day horizon as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 280.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL > 280.5 and FEDFUNDS > 0.1% indicates inflation persistence combined with rate hikes, creating a negative equity return signal as monetary policy tightens.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods meeting both CPIAUCSL > 280.5 and FEDFUNDS > 0.1% conditions.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE below 4.0% during late-cycle expansion indicates labor market tightness that sustains consumer spending (RSAFS), driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST > 1700 combined with RSAFS < 620000 indicates housing demand strength offset by retail weakness, creating sectoral imbalance that causes negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting both HOUST > 1700 and RSAFS < 620000 conditions.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 101.0 reflects industrial contraction that signals weakening economic activity, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the 5-day horizon as risk aversion spikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods where INDPRO < 101.0.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 growth above 21000 indicates robust economic expansion that fuels corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods where GDPC1 > 21000.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS exceeding 150000 signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 150000.
